# Rule collection group

One rule collection group (`Microsoft.Network/firewallPolicies/ruleCollectionGroups`) on a firewall
policy: application, network and DNAT rule collections, each a map keyed by its name, with its rules
keyed by theirs, so adding an entry never shifts the others. A collection holds one rule type only, which
the three maps enforce. The root module creates the groups in its `rule_collection_groups` input; a
separate rules state can call this submodule on its own with the policy ID, so a rule change never plans
the firewall.

Writes are serialised on the policy (`locks`), because Azure refuses parallel writes of rule collection
groups to one policy (`AnotherOperationInProgress`). The policy also stays `Updating` for minutes after a
write and refuses the next one meanwhile (`FirewallPolicyRuleCollectionGroupUpdateNotAllowed`,
`FirewallPolicyRuleCollectionGroupDeleteNotAllowed`); the default `retry` covers both. IP groups are
referenced by resource ID.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the rule collection group. Changing it replaces the group.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the firewall policy that holds the group.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_priority"></a> [priority](#input\_priority)

Description: Priority of the group within the policy, 100 to 65000; lower is processed first.

Type: `number`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_application_rule_collections"></a> [application\_rule\_collections](#input\_application\_rule\_collections)

Description: Application rule collections, by collection name. Each has:

- `priority` - 100 to 65000, unique within the group.
- `action` - `Allow` or `Deny`.
- `rules` - Application rules, by rule name:
  - `description` - (Optional) Description of the rule.
  - `source_addresses` - (Optional) Source IP addresses, CIDR prefixes or ranges.
  - `source_ip_groups` - (Optional) Source IP group resource IDs.
  - `protocols` - (Optional) Protocols, each `{ type, port }`: `type` is `Http`, `Https` or `Mssql` (SQL FQDN filtering, for example port 1433), `port` 0 to 64000.
  - `destination_fqdns` - (Optional) Destination FQDNs; `*` wildcards allowed.
  - `destination_fqdn_tags` - (Optional) FQDN tags, for example `WindowsUpdate`.
  - `destination_urls` - (Optional) Destination URLs (Premium).
  - `destination_addresses` - (Optional) Destination IP addresses or service tags.
  - `web_categories` - (Optional) Web categories.
  - `terminate_tls` - (Optional) Terminate TLS for this rule (Premium). Defaults to `false`.
  - `http_headers` - (Optional) HTTP headers to insert, by header name.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    priority = number
    action   = string
    rules = map(object({
      description           = optional(string)
      source_addresses      = optional(list(string), [])
      source_ip_groups      = optional(list(string), [])
      protocols             = optional(list(object({ type = string, port = number })), [])
      destination_fqdns     = optional(list(string), [])
      destination_fqdn_tags = optional(list(string), [])
      destination_urls      = optional(list(string), [])
      destination_addresses = optional(list(string), [])
      web_categories        = optional(list(string), [])
      terminate_tls         = optional(bool, false)
      http_headers          = optional(map(string), {})
    }))
  }))
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Paths in the rule collection group's `body` whose changes the AzAPI provider ignores. Prefer Terraform's `lifecycle.ignore_changes` when the paths are static; use this variable when the paths must be derived from variables or other non-static values.

Paths use dot notation, for example `properties.priority`. Individual list items cannot be targeted; ignore the whole list property instead. Configuration changes at an ignored path are **not** sent to Azure until that path is removed from the list. Changes take effect only after an apply, because the value is held in provider-private state.

- `network_firewall_policies_rule_collection_groups` - Ignored body paths for the rule collection group.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_firewall_policies_rule_collection_groups = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_nat_rule_collections"></a> [nat\_rule\_collections](#input\_nat\_rule\_collections)

Description: DNAT rule collections, by collection name. Each has:

- `rules` - DNAT rules, by rule name:
  - `description` - (Optional) Description of the rule.
  - `protocols` - `TCP` or `UDP`.
  - `source_addresses` - (Optional) Source IP addresses, CIDR prefixes or ranges.
  - `source_ip_groups` - (Optional) Source IP group resource IDs.

  - `destination_ports` - Destination ports, for example `["443"]`.
  - `translated_address` - (Optional) The private IP address to forward to. Exactly one of `translated_address` and `translated_fqdn`.
  - `translated_fqdn` - (Optional) The FQDN to forward to.
  - `translated_port` - The port to forward to.

Type:

```hcl

    rules = map(object({
      description         = optional(string)
      protocols           = list(string)
      source_addresses    = optional(list(string), [])
      source_ip_groups    = optional(list(string), [])
      destination_address = string
      destination_ports   = list(string)
      translated_address  = optional(string)
      translated_fqdn     = optional(string)
      translated_port     = number
    }))
  }))
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration applied to the `azapi` resource. Defaults retry `AnotherOperationInProgress`, which Azure returns while another write to the policy runs, and a rule collection group write refused while the policy is still `Updating` from the previous one (minutes after it finishes); any field can be overridden.

- `error_message_regex`  - (Optional) A list of regex patterns matching error messages that trigger a retry. Defaults to `["AnotherOperationInProgress", "Parent Firewall Policy .+ is in Updating state"]`.
- `interval_seconds`     - (Optional) Initial interval between retries in seconds. Defaults to `30`.
- `max_interval_seconds` - (Optional) Maximum interval between retries in seconds. Defaults to `300`.

See <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Azure/azapi/latest/docs/resources/resource#retry> for full semantics.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string), ["AnotherOperationInProgress", "Parent Firewall Policy .+ is in Updating state"])
    interval_seconds     = optional(number, 30)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number, 300)
  })
```

Default: `{}`

## Outputs

The following outputs are exported:

### <a name="output_lock_dependency"></a> [lock\_dependency](#output\_lock\_dependency)

Description: Changes whenever the group is created, replaced or changed. The caller passes it in the policy's `lock_dependencies`: Azure applies the policy's lock to the group too, and a `ReadOnly` lock also blocks updating it in place, which keeps its ID.

### <a name="output_name"></a> [name](#output\_name)

Description: Name of the rule collection group.

### <a name="output_resource_id"></a> [resource\_id](#output\_resource\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the rule collection group.
